chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About the qunūt in the witr, he said: “Before the rukūʿ.”
He said: “If I forget, do I perform qunūt when I raise my head?” So he said: “No.”

key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: the supplication performed in the standing position of prayer

ai.seo_question: When should qunūt be performed in the witr prayer, and what if it is forgotten?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the place of qunūt in the witr prayer, stating that it is performed before rukūʿ. It also clarifies that if it is forgotten, it is not to be performed after raising the head from rukūʿ.
